title: fairy file (.fairy, formerly .jjpet) version 2
description: One UTF-8 JSON file, at most 48 MiB (gallery: 16 MiB). See docs/pet-format.md. The app (src/shared/pet-share.ts) is the reference validator; it also checks image magic bytes and pixel dimensions, which JSON Schema cannot.

name.description: Pet name, 1-12 user-perceived letters after trimming.

species.description: Built-in body the pet uses when it has no picture, and its menu-bar runner. Unknown values read as kong.

author.description: Optional public display name of the creator. Required in the gallery. Control and bidi characters are stripped.

created.description: ISO 8601 date or UTC date-time, 2020 or later.

age.description: Illustration age stage (baby and teen are drawn smaller). Only with images.main.

main.description: The pet picture. Without it the pet is the built-in species body.

poses.description: Mood pictures. Only used with images.main. A broken pose is dropped by the app (rejected by the gallery).

thumbnail.description: PNG, longest side at most 512 px, at most 256 KiB. Required in the gallery.

blueprint.description: Optional 3D figure blueprint (parts + face), as made by the app. Only with images.main. Parsed and clamped by src/shared/pet3d/blueprint.ts.

depth.description: Optional grayscale relief depth PNG (2.5D), at most 1 MiB. Only with images.main and without blueprint.

image.description: Base64 data URL, decoded at most 8 MiB, at most 4096 px per side and 16 megapixels.
